name: P7_LEMMA5_6_7_10_HYPOTHESIS_ERASURE_GATE

parents.paper_II: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring

scope: Static proof dependency audit of Lemmas 5,6,7,10 only. No graph enumeration. No SPLIT4 modification. No acceptability/Break-B repair.

questions.L5_CLASS_ERASURE: Is the P6-free hypothesis unused in every inference of Lemma 5, so the statement holds for arbitrary graphs under the remaining hypotheses?
questions.L7_CLASS_ERASURE: Does Lemma 7 depend on graph class only through Lemma 5, so generalized Lemma 5 yields generalized Lemma 7?
questions.L6_P7_LIFT: Can every inference of Lemma 6 be replayed for P7-free G, with the only class-sensitive algorithmic call replaced/bound to polynomial List 3-Coloring on P7-free induced subgraphs?
questions.L10_P7_LIFT: Does the proof of Lemma 10 use graph class only through Lemmas 6 and 7, so lifted L6+L7 imply a P7-free version of Lemma 10?

theorem2_audit_contract.source_statement_in_paper: Theorem 2: 3-coloring is polynomial-time solvable for P7-free graphs.
theorem2_audit_contract.cited_reference: Bonomo et al., Three-coloring and list three-coloring of graphs without induced paths on seven vertices, Combinatorica 38(4), 779-801.
theorem2_audit_contract.exact_subproblem_in_lemma6: Given H=G'|(V(C) union A), decide whether the precoloring on A extends using only the three colors [4]\{c}.
required_bridge: H must be an induced subgraph of G and hence P7-free when G is P7-free.
The subproblem is a List 3-Coloring instance: singleton lists on A and the full three-color set on C.
A polynomial List 3-Coloring algorithm for P7-free graphs suffices without graph modification or gadgets.

audit_method: Read each proof line-by-line from the primary manuscript.
Classify every inference as structural, normal-subcase, axiom-based, general graph lemma, graph-class invocation, or algorithmic subroutine.
Any unaccounted use of P6-freeness yields FAIL for the corresponding transfer.
No empirical examples may promote a lemma transfer.
promotion_rule: PASS_P7_LEMMA5_6_7_10_TRANSFER only if all four subclaims pass.
